title: Study OS
tagline: Find the real point of confusion
description: A public research project asking a harder question than whether an answer is right: was the learner blocked by the concept, the representation, the source code, or the tutor? Built from real learner sessions, source-linked evidence, and an evolving learning system you can inspect on GitHub.

title: Ekagajpatra
description: Architected and built a scalable platform serving 35,000+ users, transforming complex documentation into guided workflows with validation, PDF generation, and multi-role dashboards.

title: InvestAI
description: Built a working MVP financial learning platform using AI for sentiment analysis and market credibility evaluation, tested by 10+ financial experts.

title: ONI vs My Agent Ready Architecture
description: Software architecture has not caught up with agent-first coding yet. I built an npm package so repos keep agent speed without losing planning time, audit trails, or architecture shape, with modular boundaries, contracts, versioned dev logs, agent-readable JSON audits, prompt versioning, evals, and patch/rollback context stronger than git alone. Tested with multi-agent pipelines up to 500 agents.

title: SaaS Dashboard
description: Enterprise admin system for legal, financial, and business clients with role-based access and advanced analytics.

title: FOSSIL
description: Human-led technical work already creates the evidence. FOSSIL preserves the sources, tests, rejected paths and changing reasoning behind a decision so months later you can see why you made the call instead of asking AI to invent the story again.
